import axios from'axios';const API_URL='/api/auth';// 注册
const register=userData=>{return axios.post("".concat(API_URL,"/register"),userData);};// 登录
const login=async credentials=>{const response=await axios.post("".concat(API_URL,"/login"),credentials);if(response.data.token){localStorage.setItem('user',JSON.stringify(response.data));}return response.data;};// 登出
const logout=()=>{localStorage.removeItem('user');};// 获取当前用户
const getCurrentUser=()=>{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user'));};// 更新密码
const updatePassword=passwords=>{const{token}=getCurrentUser();return axios.put("".concat(API_URL,"/update-password"),passwords,{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(token)}});};const authService={register,login,logout,getCurrentUser,updatePassword};export default authService;
